column1: # Designed to be a drop-in for the previous 4MB no_ota layout so the
# currently-flashed firmware boots unchanged from the new table:
#   - ota_0 = old app0 at 0x10000/0x1F0000 → existing firmware boots from here
#   - otadata at 0x3F0000/0x2000 (where coredump used to sit; coredump dropped)
#   - ota_1   at 0x400000/0x1F0000 (second app slot — OTA target)
# Bootloader reads otadata to pick ota_0 vs ota_1. Erased otadata → ota_0.
